palette: polling grove dark green ground + ballot-paper cream panels + bamboo-green tick accents + vermilion vote seals + ink rule lines + brass gate posts
typography: ink headings on ballot-paper plaques, dark station label tabs with vermilion left bar, vermilion stamps reserved for double-half verdicts and prohibitions, bamboo chips for direct-election items, brass chips for indirect items, thin ink underline for tests
composition: five principles queue as a rule rail; the direct-indirect compare board faces two stations; the candidate board forks nomination margins and publicity times; the voting bench runs ballots through a double-half gate to a result strip; the review wall closes with five questions and recall rules
surface: flat dark green ground with faint gate-rail hairlines, ballot panels with hairline weathered borders and corner gate posts, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: ballot panels slide through the gate line, principle rows tick in with bamboo marks, the fork arms swing once, seals stamp on passage verdicts, the review wall bricks fill
transition: a gate arm lifts and the station clears for the next ballot
